_note: Not an opponent: the reader the game asks what a position is worth to the person (spec 8.5, docs/opponent/README.md 'The game, stage 2'): which pot the next-ball pick turns to, and when a pot left an excellent position. Never listed for the picker. Its aim error is the owner's own, as game/scripts/play/next_target.gd fitted it to his logged shots (AIM_SIGMA_RAD, CUT_SIGMA_PER_RAD); no error is ever drawn from it. 'values' is what is loaded; 'docs' gives each value's unit, source and note.

name.note: Not shown: this reader is never offered as an opponent.

tier.note: 0: outside the ladder, as the 147. The binding keeps this level out of levels().

aim_sigma_rad.source: game/scripts/play/next_target.gd AIM_SIGMA_RAD, fitted to the owner's 262 logged shots of 2026-11-15
aim_sigma_rad.note: The owner's aim error on a straight pot, set against the same geometric margin the pick reads. The pick also caps a pot's chance at MAX_CHANCE (0.9, the easy pot in ten he still misses); a level's chance has no cap, so the reader's chance is the pick's over 0.9.

aim_sigma_per_cut.note: The aim's sigma grows by this fraction per radian of cut.

aim_sigma_per_m.note: 0: the pick's fit has no term for distance; the margin it is set against already shrinks with the cue ball's travel.

awkward_factor.note: 1: the pick's fit has no term for hampered cueing.

speed_sigma.note: 0: no stroke is played with this reader's error.

tip_sigma.note: 0: no stroke is played with this reader's error.

max_cut_rad.note: It does not consider a pot with a wider cut, as the pick does not.

max_tip.note: 0: it reads every pot as a centre-ball stroke.

speeds.note: Cue speeds it tries for a pot, for what each leaves.

spins.note: Tip offsets it tries for a pot; the first is centre ball.

depth.note: 0: it reads what each pot leaves, and looks no further.

position_weight.note: How much the position a pot leaves counts beside the pot itself.

judgement_sigma.note: 0: it reads every pot as it is.

safety_below.note: 0: it pots whenever it has a pot, as the pick suggests one whenever there is one.

max_sims.source: ours, from the time the return may take
max_sims.note: Simulations it may run for one suggestion; the binding's 400 ms clock stops it first on a slow device.

tactics.note: 0 the stand-in's plain safety; 1 basic safeties; 2 weighs them by the leave, with side; 3 also lays snookers and escapes with swerve.

safety_tries.note: Safeties, snookers and escapes it weighs for one stroke.

escape_cushions.note: Cushions it will go off to escape a snooker.

miss_weight.note: How much of what a miss leaves the other player it counts against a pot.

noisy_sims.note: Strokes with its own error it simulates to learn a pot's chance; 0 reads the geometric margin.

score_aware.note: How far the score moves its risk.

concede_snookers.source: the owner (M3): the computer concedes only when it needs snookers

maximum.note: false: it reads a position, it does not play for a maximum.
